name: grid-fragment-varying-inline-fr-columns
derivation: Continuation policy: retain accepted row/column placements but resolve flexible column sizes against each fragment's inline space. Grid section 13 does not prescribe an exact fragmented layout. With a 3px column gap, width123 leaves 120px for 1fr+2fr: widths40/80 at x0/43. Width93 on page 2 leaves 90px: widths30/60 at x0/33. The second 23px row is forced onto page 2 at y91, so the 5px row gap at the break is suppressed. The root fragments use their respective frame widths123/93; their block extents are the consumed first frame's 73px and final row's 23px. No item's intrinsic minimum constrains the fr calculation.
